MenuLink.description: A navigation link. `link` is relative to the app root unless `is_external` is set.
MenuLink.title: MenuLink

UserData.description: The current user, its main character and the permissions the UI depends on.
UserData.title: UserData

UserSettingsSchema.description: Notification settings of the current user.
UserSettingsSchema.title: UserSettingsSchema

AdminUpdateRequest.description: Request to queue an update. Without `eve_id` all owners of the target are updated.
AdminUpdateRequest.title: AdminUpdateRequest

AdminOwnerSchema.description: A character, corporation or alliance in the administration lists.
AdminOwnerSchema.title: AdminOwnerSchema

AdministrationResponse.description:
Everything the administration page of an account, corporation or alliance shows.

Attributes:
    owner: The account's main character, corporation or alliance.
    dashboard: Registration statistics.
    registered: Entries registered in the ledger.
    missing: Entries that exist but are not registered.
    members: Characters of a corporation that are known to Auth.
AdministrationResponse.title: AdministrationResponse

AltSchema.description: Alt character that is included in an entity's ledger.
AltSchema.title: AltSchema

DashboardSchema.description: Statistics shown on the administration dashboards.
DashboardSchema.title: DashboardSchema

OwnerSchema.description:
Schema for Character or Character Owner.

Attributes:
    character_id (int): The ID of the character.
    character_name (str): The name of the character.
    icon (str | None): The URL of the character's icon, if available.
OwnerSchema.title: OwnerSchema

DateFilter.description: Date query parameters shared by all ledger endpoints, applied to `date`.
DateFilter.title: DateFilter

CharacterLedgerResponse.description:
Schema for Character Ledger Response.

Attributes:
    characters (list[LedgerCharacterSchema]): List of character ledger data.
CharacterLedgerResponse.title: CharacterLedgerResponse

CharacterLedgerSchema.description:
Schema for Character Ledger extending LedgerSchema.

Subclass of :class:`LedgerSchema`.

Attributes:
    mining (float): Amount related to mining activities.
CharacterLedgerSchema.title: CharacterLedgerSchema

LedgerDetailsResponse.description:
Flexible schema for detailed ledger categories.

Attributes:
    summary (CategorySchema): Summary of all categories.
    daily (CategorySchema): Daily breakdown of categories.
    hourly (CategorySchema): Hourly breakdown of categories.
LedgerDetailsResponse.title: LedgerDetailsResponse

LedgerDetailsSummary.description:
Schema for the totals of ledger details.

Attributes:
    summary (float): Total of all categories.
    daily (float): Daily average of all categories.
    hourly (float): Hourly average of all categories.
LedgerDetailsSummary.title: LedgerDetailsSummary

RefTypeAmountSchema.description: Amount that a single reference type contributed to a category.
RefTypeAmountSchema.title: RefTypeAmountSchema

PlanetSelection.description: Selects one planet, or all planets of the character if omitted.
PlanetSelection.title: PlanetSelection

EveTypeSchema.description:
Schema for EVE Online item types.

Attributes:
    id (int): The ID of the item type.
    name (str): The name of the item type.
    description (str | None): The description of the item type, if available.
    group_id (int | None): The group ID of the item type, if available.
    group_name (str | None): The group name of the item type, if available.
    market_group_id (int | None): The market group ID of the item type, if available.
    market_group_name (str | None): The market group name of the item type, if available.
    icon (str | None): The URL of the item type's icon, if available.
EveTypeSchema.title: EveTypeSchema

PlanetaryDetails.description: A planet of a character. `id` is the identifier for the detail and notification endpoints.
PlanetaryDetails.title: PlanetaryDetails

CorporationLedgerFilter.description: Query parameters for corporation ledgers, optionally limited to one division.
CorporationLedgerFilter.title: CorporationLedgerFilter

AltLedgerSchema.description: Contribution of one alt character to the ledger of its entity.
AltLedgerSchema.title: AltLedgerSchema

CorporationLedgerResponse.description:
Schema for Corporation Ledger Response.

Attributes:
    entities (list[LedgerEntitySchema]): The list of ledger entities.
    divisions (list[DivisionSchema]): The wallet divisions to choose from.
CorporationLedgerResponse.title: CorporationLedgerResponse

DivisionSchema.description: A wallet division of a corporation.
DivisionSchema.title: DivisionSchema

EntitySchema.description:
Schema for Entity or Corporation Owner.

Attributes:
    entity_id (int): The ID of the entity.
    entity_name (str): The name of the entity.
    alt_ids (list[int]): The IDs of all characters included in the entity.
    alts (list[AltSchema]): The alt characters included in the entity.
    icon (str | None): The URL of the entity's icon, if available.
EntitySchema.title: EntitySchema

LedgerSchema.description:
Schema for Ledger Summary.

Attributes:
    bounty (float): Amount related to bounties.
    ess (float): Amount related to ESS activities.
    costs (float): Amount related to costs.
    miscellaneous (float): Miscellaneous amount.
    total (float): Total amount.
LedgerSchema.title: LedgerSchema

AllianceLedgerResponse.description:
Schema for Alliance Ledger API Response

Attributes:
    corporations (list[LedgerAllianceSchema]): A list of ledger entities associated with the alliance.
AllianceLedgerResponse.title: AllianceLedgerResponse
